meta.description: Short screen recordings of the real app: Link, CRM, Cal, Track, Chat and Docs.

label: Videos
title: See it working.
sub: Short screen recordings of the real app, with captions. No mockups, no audio.
note: Recorded in the app's demo mode with sample data.

zerosoft-intro.title: What is zerosoft
zerosoft-intro.desc: A 48-second tour of six of the apps and how to switch between them.

crm.title: CRM
crm.desc: Contacts with saved views and filters, a contact's timeline, dragging deals across stages and the deal stage bar.

link.title: Link
link.desc: Create a short link with a custom slug, tags and UTM, then see clicks by referrer, country and device.

cal.title: Cal
cal.desc: Event types, the public booking page, picking a slot and booking. Then the booking in your app.

track.title: Track
track.desc: A project's issues as a list and as a board, then an issue with its properties and a comment.

chat.title: Chat
chat.desc: The shared inbox: reply to a visitor, resolve the conversation and see everyone in People.

docs.title: Docs
docs.desc: Nested pages, to-dos, tables and code blocks, and comments on a page.
